name: e11-seat0-holder
comment: E11 / check 5: B enters a mounted turret and takes damage while A watches.
This client is neither A nor B. It exists to OCCUPY SEAT 0, and that is structural:
the only MountedTurret in the project is on tank.prefab and it is the GUNNER seat's
weapon -- index 1 of the Vehicle's two-entry seats array -- while ClientSeatRequester
always asks for seat 0 and reaches index 1 only by being told RejectedOccupied.
A lone client takes seat 0, gets no turret, and grades nothing.
This client toggles one step BEFORE OBS-B so seat 0 is booked when OBS-B asks.
Checkpoints fire at their step's ENTRY, so each one is named for the state it can
already see rather than for the action its own step is about to take.
